summary: Replaced node1’s expired certificate with a self-signed certificate for DNS:node1, valid from 2026-09-02 through 2027-09-02. Nginx reloaded gracefully, all 725 continuity probes succeeded, and the original 61-byte content remained unchanged. Both nodes were then restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Captured certificate, HTTPS content, service, and boot baselines.
Generated and validated a 3072-bit self-signed certificate with SAN DNS:node1 and 365-day validity.
Installed the certificate and key with modes 0644 and 0600 after creating rollback copies.
Validated Nginx configuration and performed a graceful reload; the master PID remained unchanged.
Verified 725 consecutive remote requests with zero failures and an unchanged response hash.
Removed temporary certificate and rollback copies.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time, proving changed boot identities and post-restart recovery.

evidence.summary: The previous certificate expired 2025-01-01. Both nodes observed HTTP 200, 61 bytes, and SHA-256 03c83eaf2290bab30f782c454868decf87f8de9eb50d08d236cc61688bdd9ddb.

evidence.requirement: Replacement certificate valid for node1 for at least 180 days
evidence.summary: Validated self-signature, matching key, SAN DNS:node1, CA:FALSE, serverAuth usage, and validity through 2027-09-02.

evidence.requirement: Safe rotation with endpoint availability and preserved content
evidence.summary: Nginx configuration passed and gracefully reloaded without changing its master PID. All 725 remote probes returned HTTP 200 with the unchanged byte count and hash; node2 independently validated the served certificate.

Healthy baseline boot ID e5bd5a63-fd5e-4e53-8a4a-6c0c574dcb9d; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 61d94c77-f9c5-4134-beaf-70c9f13651c6; Nginx, certificate, key, listener, HTTP response, and independent node2 access recovered.

Baseline boot ID 872e8664-0b74-4ab3-a106-477ff0451f37 with working networking and endpoint access; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID e0e6f0a1-dc19-414f-9466-54f052e96bcb; networking and remote certificate/content validation recovered while node1 remained healthy.
